data.name: Casino Tycoon: Sin & Win
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Neon Babylon—a city where the dice never stop rolling, the champagne never stops flowing, and every win comes with a price.
Once the heir to a gambling empire, you now crawl back from the gutters with nothing but a stolen dealer’s chip and a hunger for revenge.

High-Stakes Gambling:

In the casino, you'll experience a variety of games such as slot machines, blackjack, and Keno. Starting as a novice, you'll gradually hone your skills and become a master gambler, placing ever-larger bets. As your VIP level rises, you'll gain access to increasingly lavish entertainment options, ultimately unlocking the most exclusive services reserved for the top floor of the casino.

Fully Armed:

Switch between drone、rifles, sniper rifles, Gatling guns, pistols, and a wide array of other weapons during combat to handle any situation.

Freedom on the Road:

Drive various luxury cars through the city's streets and alleys. During your journey, turn on the radio to play your favorite music, setting the rhythm for your drive.

Wealth & Collection:

Use the money you earn in-game to purchase more powerful weapons and more luxurious vehicles.

Boundless Exploration:

Freely explore this vast city. You can climb over low walls, dive deep into the ocean for a swim, or even pilot an aircraft and soar through the skies.

A Living World:

The game world features a simulated real-city traffic system and populations of pedestrians, together creating a dynamic, living, breathing backdrop for you to explore at will.

Match more players online:

You can engage in gunfights with other players in the city and loot their cash. You can also form your own gang to help you dominate as the casino tycoon.

You’ll Love This If You:

✓ Enjoyed the vibes of "GTA meets Casino Royale"

✓ Laughed when Scarface said "Say hello to my little friend"

✓ Think stock markets are for cowards

You’ll Hate This If You:

✗ Believe in "responsible gaming"

✗ Blush at fishnet stockings

✗ Still use Monopoly money for practice

LAST CALL:

The roulette wheel is spinning. The gun’s loaded. The bed’s silk sheets are freshly turned.

Place your bets, tycoon.

data.short_description: Rise from a broke gambler to a casino kingpin in this high-stakes sim blending management, gambling, and adult content. Win big, indulge in luxury, go bankrupt, or start a gang war—every choice writes your destiny. In this city, you either rule the tables… or end up in a ditch.
data.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GEFORCE GTX 1060 6GB or AMD RADEON RX580 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I9-8700K or AMD RYZEN 9 5900X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GEFORCE RTX 4050 8GB or AMD RADEON RX7600M XT‌
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
